_note: For each archetype: 3 sample prompts (2 targets, 1 adversarial) and 3 voice recipes (wide / sharp / narrow). Each recipe declares explicitly which prompt IDs it fires on, so the teaching moment is deterministic.

samplePrompts.text: Write up how the auth middleware works for the onboarding doc.
Chronicle the decisions we've made about caching so far.
Scaffold a new React component for the settings panel.

recipes.label: The Wide Net
recipes.description: Use this skill for help with anything in the codebase.
recipes.lesson: Catches everything — even things that aren't yours.

recipes.label: The Sharp Focus
recipes.description: Use this skill when the user asks to document, explain, or summarize existing code and decisions.
recipes.lesson: Fires on what it's for. Stays quiet otherwise.

recipes.label: The Narrow Point
recipes.description: Use this skill only when chronicling caching decisions in the billing module.
recipes.lesson: Too specific — misses targets it should catch.
